productCategoryId, jpc.`name` AS productCategoryName, jp.specification AS productSpecification, null AS createdAt, jii.quantity AS quantity, null AS orderId, null AS warehouseName, '期初余额' AS operationType, jp.remarks AS productRemarks, ju.`name` AS unitName, null AS supplierId, null AS supplierName, null AS customerId, null AS customerName, jii.unit_price AS unitPrice, null AS subtotal, sum(jii.current_quantity) AS currentQuantity, sum(jii.total_cost) AS totalCost, sum(jii.current_quantity) AS summaryQuantity, sum(jii.total_cost) AS summaryCost, jii.average_cost AS averageCost, (jii.product_id,jii.inventory_date) IN ( SELECT jii.product_id,max(jii.inventory_date) FROM jxc_inventory_item jii LEFT JOIN jxc_product jp ON (jp.id = jii.product_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_product_category warehouse_id ) ) LEFT JOIN jxc_product_category jpc ON (jpc.id = jp.product_category_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_warehouse jw ON (jw.id = jii.warehouse_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_unit ju ON (ju.id = jp.unit_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_customer jc ON (jc.id = jii.customer_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_supplier js ON (js.id = jii.supplier_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_finance_voucher jfv ON (jfv.order_id = jii.id) WHERE jp.merchant_id = :merchantId (:supplierIds)] #[AND jp.id in (:productIds)] #[AND jw.id in (:warehouseIds)] #[AND jpc.id in (:productCategoryIds)] #[AND jc.id in (:customerIds)] #[AND jii.operation_type in (:operationTypes) OR productName, jp.product_category_id AS productCategoryId, jpc.`name` AS productCategoryName, jp.specification AS productSpecification, jii.created_at AS createdAt, jii.quantity AS quantity, jii.order_id AS orderId, jw.`name` AS warehouseName, jii.operation_type AS operationType, jp.remarks AS productRemarks, ju.`name` AS unitName, js.`id` AS supplierId, js.`name` AS supplierName, jc.`id` AS customerId, jc.`name` AS customerName, jii.unit_price AS unitPrice, jii.subtotal AS subtotal, jii.current_quantity AS currentQuantity, jii.total_cost AS totalCost, jii.summary_quantity AS summaryQuantity, jii.summary_cost AS summaryCost, jii.average_cost AS averageCost, jii.summary_average AS summaryAverage, jii.inventory_date AS inventoryDate, jfv.voucher_id AS voucherId, jfv.`code` AS voucherCode FROM jxc_inventory_item jii LEFT JOIN jxc_product jp ON (jp.id = jii.product_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_product_category jpc ON (jpc.id = jp.product_category_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_warehouse jw ON (jw.id = jii.warehouse_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_unit ju ON (ju.id = jp.unit_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_customer jc ON (jc.id = jii.customer_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_supplier js ON (js.id = jii.supplier_id) LEFT JOIN jxc_finance_voucher jfv ON (jfv.order_id = jii.id) WHERE jii.merchant_id = :merchantId AND jii.account_book_id = :accountBookId AND jii.operation_type <> '期初库存' AND jii.operation_type <> '期初入库' #[AND jii.inventory_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] #[AND (jii.batch_number like :filter OR jp.`name` like :filter)] #[AND js.id in (:supplierIds)] #[AND jp.id in (:productIds)] #[AND jw.id in (:warehouseIds)] #[AND jpc.id in (:productCategoryIds)] #[AND jc.id in (:customerIds)] #[AND jii.operation_type in (:operationTypes)] ) t ORDER BY t.productId ASC, t.sn DESC, t.inventoryDate ASC
